```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```
```{r}
# The head() function with gt() is used to visualise the first ten lines.

# Need to include data/ followed by the name of the file.

chart <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(chart)
```
```{r}
ggplot(chart, aes(
  x = period_start,
  y = metric_value,
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "red")
xlab("Date")
ylab("Number of Measles Cases)")
ggtitle("Number of Measles Cases by Date")
```
